title: VAANI: Capturing the language landscape for an inclusive digital India

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) Word Error Rates (WER) and Language Identification (LID) accuracy across a diverse set of officially recognized major Indic languages and traditionally underrepresented, low-resource languages (e.g., Chakma, Bhojpuri).

Measuring the Word Error Rate (WER) of ASR models fine-tuned on state-specific speech data when evaluated on speakers from geographically proximate versus distant states, demonstrating performance disparities across regions even within the same macro-language (Hindi).
